## What's fixed

- **Select ROM** now works on Linux setups without a desktop file-dialog
  service, such as Batocera and other console-style sessions. Previously the
  launcher stopped with `File dialog error: Failed to execute program
  org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop` and offered no way to choose a ROM
  ([#46](https://github.com/ThiagoLira/trouble-makers-pc-recomp/issues/46)).
- When the native dialog is unavailable, the launcher now opens its own
  controller-friendly ROM browser. Use the D-pad or stick to move, A or Enter
  to open a folder or choose a ROM, and B or Escape to go back. It starts in
  the folder the AppImage was launched from and lists `.z64`, `.n64`, and
  `.v64` files; turn on **Show all files** for dumps with other extensions.
- Desktops with a working file dialog still use the native dialog.

## Validation

- Without a file-dialog service, both with no D-Bus and with D-Bus but no
  portal (the Batocera case), Select ROM opened the built-in browser. Moving
  between folders, rejecting a non-ROM file, and choosing a US 1.1 ROM all
  worked.
- On a GNOME desktop, Select ROM still opened the native file dialog.
- Linux and Windows CI builds passed.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/ThiagoLira/trouble-makers-pc-recomp/compare/v0.8.2...v0.8.3
